description: This file defines a class I18NTranslationDecorator which extends the functionality of I18NTranslation entities with decorator methods and uses traits for entity management. It appears to be part of a multilingual translation feature within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: I18NTranslationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for I18NTranslation entities, providing methods to associate language strings and language entities by IDs, utilizing trait-provided entity reference resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with an I18NTranslation instance.

methods.name: getI18NTranslation
methods.description: Protected getter for the wrapped I18NTranslation entity.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLangString entity with the translation by ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLanguage entity with the translation by ID.
